tours.title: Announcements

Click create
See the new announcement on the list
Click view on the announcement
Read the announcement

tours.title: Dealer payments and ledger

Check the top-up details and submit for verification
Verify the ledger top-up
Check the ledger balance
Pay the order advance from the ledger
Check the dealer's payment history

tours.completion: The dealer topped up the ledger, accounts verified it, and the dealer paid the order advance from the ledger. The OEM sees both movements in the dealer's payment history. Next in the real flow: the OEM raises production for the paid order (see Dealer order to dealer delivery).

tours.title: Dealer settings and users

steps.action: Read the dealer profile and the settings
Read the staff user list
Click create
Add {staff.newUser.firstName} as a {staff.newUser.role} and submit
Read the staff user list after the submit

tours.completion: {dealer.firm} profile is shown. The staff user list now shows {staff.count} staff users, including {staff.newUser.firstName} as {staff.newUser.role}. The N11 role assignment for a dealer and its sub-dealers is not defined yet.

tours.title: Setting up dealer

steps.action: Open Dealers from the menu
Click add
Check the dealer details and click save
Open the new dealer
Check the dealer profile, then hand over the login details
Sign in with the user ID and password
Save the shop location or choose not now
Check the dealer dashboard

tours.completion: The new dealer is set up and its owner has signed in for the first time. Next in the real flow: the dealer places its first purchase order.

tours.title: Dealer stock and issues

Pick the line, describe the issue and click Submit & confirm
See the issue at stage Manager review
Approve the issue at manager review
Approve the issue at OEM review
Settle with money: enter the compensation amount and transaction ID
See the stage and outcome on the Issues List

tours.completion: The issue on {order.id} is resolved: {issue.outcome}, {issue.compensation|inr}. {users.dealer-owner.name} sees the stage and outcome on the Issues List.

tours.title: Enquiry to invoice

steps.action: Click new
Check the enquiry details and click create
Open the follow-up log
Add a follow-up
The customer wants a quote: click create
Check the vehicle, variant and colour, then click create
The customer agrees: convert the enquiry to a customer
Check the customer details and click create
Open the payment tab to record the booking advance
Click + new
Check the advance payment and click create
Check that the vehicle is in stock
Check the spares in stock
Click + new
Check the vehicle and serials, then click create
Print the invoice

tours.completion: The enquiry became a customer, the customer paid a booking advance, and the vehicle was invoiced from dealer stock with the chassis bound to the customer. The invoice is Pending because only the advance is paid. Next in the real flow: the customer pays the balance (D23, linked to the invoice) and the OEM sees it read only (O07, O08, O09).

Click MU stock
Read the MU stock and the in-transit material

Read the dispatch plan calendar for {dispatchPlan.month}
Check the connect a dealer search
Read the unit asset register requirement

Read the QC inspection stage
